claim_boundary: these 80 exact direct Gram certificates close only the recorded residual target vectors and their coordinatewise same-parity length descendants; this artifact does not convert the other 25,760 favorable-cycle targets into direct Grams and therefore makes no full order-nine closure claim

gram.descendant_lift: increasing any physical path length by an even nonnegative amount preserves t_p and weakly decreases its positive summand; each certificate therefore owns every coordinatewise same-parity length descendant of its recorded target vector
gram.psd_proof: exact symmetric LDL^T with nine strictly positive rational pivots per matrix (hence positive definite and positive semidefinite)

proposal_provenance.acceptance: only exact symmetry, unit diagonal, positive LDL pivots, and Fraction cost at most 6 are trusted
proposal_provenance.objective: minimize the path-bound cost for each of the 80 target vectors
proposal_provenance.rationalization: mix the proposed matrix with I using (15/16)G+(1/16)I, set the diagonal exactly to 1, and apply Fraction.limit_denominator(64) independently to off-diagonal entries
proposal_provenance.role: proposal only; no numerical value is consumed by the exact verifier
proposal_provenance.solver: CVXPY 1.9.3 with CLARABEL on the unit-diagonal positive-semidefinite elliptope
